name: package_durations
title: owner-review.md 'Package durations' (plugin version 9, save nvftest, one run of about 50 real minutes): a full game day in Novac from 08:00 with six residents tracked whose packages have a start hour and a duration, among them short travel and patrol packages whose goal can be met before or after the duration ends: Boone (PatrolToHome 9:00 for 2 h, Sandbox 9:00 for 12 h, PatrolToNest 21:00 for 12 h), Manny Vargas (PatrolToNest 9:00 for 12 h, PatrolToHome 21:00 for 2 h, Sandbox 21:00 for 12 h), Cliff Briscoe (shop sandbox 6:00 for 17 h, PatrolHome 22:00 for 1 h, Sleep 22:00 for 8 h), Andy (Sandbox 8:00 for 13 h, Sleep 22:00 for 10 h), No-bark (Patrol 9:00 for 12 h) and Jeannie May (Sleep 22:00 for 6 h) [the records, fnvtool ai show]. The package events (OnPackageStart/Change/Done) give when each package began, ended and reached its goal (Done); the samples give procedure DONE, position and cell. Compare each switch with the package's start + duration and with the moment its goal was done.

sessions.name: novac_day
sessions.note: the player stands by Jeannie May at the motel office all day; the residents are in the loaded area most of the time
